description: Extension of OnboardingView that provides SwiftUI layout and UI components for onboarding screens, including navigation, page management, and view helpers.

methods.name: activePageIndex(for:)
methods.description: Calculates the active page index for a given cursor position, clamping to valid range.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange(previousActivePageIndex:)
methods.description: Reconciles the current page based on previous mode change, moving to closest page index.

methods.name: navigationBar
methods.description: Constructs the navigation bar UI with back, page indicators, and next buttons.

methods.name: onboardingPage(_:)
methods.description: Wraps content in a scroll view with styling specific for onboarding pages.

methods.name: onboardingCard(spacing:padding:)
methods.description: Creates a styled card view with padding and rounded corners.

methods.name: onboardingGlassCard(spacing:padding:)
methods.description: Creates a transparent, glass-effect styled card view.

methods.name: featureRow(title:subtitle:systemImage:)
methods.description: Creates a UI row with icon, title, and subtitle.

methods.name: featureActionRow(title:subtitle:systemImage:buttonTitle:action:)
methods.description: Creates a feature row with a button action.

methods.name: featureRowContent(title:subtitle:systemImage:action:?)
methods.description: Internal helper to create the content layout for feature rows.
